content: Vue 3.5.39 is latest per npm registry. Vite is at major v8.1.4. Pinia 3.0.4 is the official state management recommendation for Vue 3 Composition API. Vue Router has two active majors: v4.6.3 (stable, no file-based routing) and v5.1.0 (adds optional file-based routing via absorbed unplugin-vue-router, no breaking changes vs v4 if that feature unused).
